name: Airfield Directory MCP
description: Your AI co-pilot for flight planning. Search 40,000+ airfields worldwide by ICAO code, name, or city. Get live METAR/TAF weather with runway-specific crosswind analysis and hazard decoding. Compare landing fees and fuel prices from Aerops. Read community pilot reports with insider tips on transport, facilities, and local quirks. Perform geo searches. View live airfield webcams. Plan routes across regions with smart filtering by IFR capability, fuel type, runway length, and community ratings. Free, public, no account needed.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Read-only public airfield data for machine clients.

tool.name: airfield_get
tool.description: Get comprehensive information for one airfield or airport by ICAO code. Sections include core data and ratings, landing and parking fees with fuel prices, contact details, community pilot reports (PIREPs), car-rental availability, and webcam discovery. Always read the PIREPs carefully — they contain first-hand local knowledge from pilots who flew there: transport links, facilities, restaurants, hotels, fuel quirks, and operational tips not found in structured data. Provide arrival/departure and optionally tailsign for live Aerops fee and app2drive car-rental pricing. For weather, use airfield_weather_get instead.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Airfield Directory MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Airfield Directory MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://airfield.directory/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Airfield Directory MCP MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Airfield Directory MCP scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Airfield Directory MCP's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Airfield Directory MCP scores 70/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 8 of 8 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Airfield Directory MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Airfield Directory MCP provides these MCP tools: taxonomy_list, airfield_search, airfield_list_by_h3, airfield_get, airfield_weather_get, and airfield_webcam_image.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Airfield Directory MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Airfield Directory MCP in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Airfield Directory MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Airfield Directory MCP does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
